feature-dev.title: Led Development of Key Features
feature-dev.description: Spearheaded the design and implementation of customer-facing features that scaled to serve thousands of daily active users.
details: Architected a real-time notification system reducing user response time by 40%
Designed and built a dashboard used by 5,000+ users daily
Drove adoption of feature flags for safer, incremental rollouts

perf-optimization.title: System Performance Optimization
perf-optimization.description: Identified and resolved critical performance bottlenecks across the application stack.
details: Reduced API response times by 60% through query optimization and caching
Implemented database indexing strategies that cut read latency in half
Set up performance monitoring and alerting dashboards

mentoring.title: Engineering Mentorship & Code Quality
mentoring.description: Established code review practices and mentored junior engineers to improve team velocity and code quality.
details: Mentored 3 junior engineers through structured 1:1 sessions
Introduced PR review guidelines adopted across the engineering org
Led weekly knowledge-sharing sessions on system design topics

api-dev.title: RESTful API & Microservices Development
api-dev.description: Designed, built, and maintained a suite of RESTful APIs powering the core product.
details: Built 12+ microservices handling authentication, payments, and notifications
Wrote comprehensive API documentation using OpenAPI/Swagger
Achieved 99.9% uptime through robust error handling and circuit breakers

cross-team.title: Cross-Functional Product Delivery
cross-team.description: Worked closely with product, design, and QA teams to deliver features on schedule.
details: Participated in sprint planning and backlog grooming with product managers
Translated design mockups into pixel-perfect, accessible UI components
Reduced release cycle time by 30% through CI/CD pipeline improvements
